updateRestartTip: Version {version} is downloaded. Restart MyFiles to use it.
settingsOpenFoldersHint: Folders opened from the desktop and from other programs open here instead of in File Explorer. Programs that ask File Explorer itself to show a file still get File Explorer.
settingsDefaultHint: Both are settings of your user account alone, and turning them off puts back what was there.
settingsConfirmTrash: Ask before moving files to the Recycle Bin
settingsRestoreTabs: Reopen the last session's tabs at startup
searchReadingDrives: Still reading the drives: more may turn up
searchResultsOf: {count, number} of {total, plural, one {# result} other {# results}}
searchUnknownToken: A filter after “:” is not one MyFiles knows
settingsSearchFuzzy: Match letters scattered in a name
settingsSearchFuzzyHint: “rdm” finds readme.md. Turned off, a word must be in the name as typed; put ' before a word to flip it for that word.
settingsSearchOrFirstHint: “a | b c” then means (a or b) and c, where it otherwise means a or (b and c).
settingsSearchHistory: Put files opened from results before the others
settingsIndexOn: Keep an index of file names for instant search
settingsIndexHint: Drives are followed as they change: NTFS drives by their journal, which also tells what changed while MyFiles was closed; other drives while MyFiles runs, and read again from time to time. A folder no index covers is read when it is searched, which takes longer.
settingsIndexFast: Read NTFS Drives the Fast Way…
settingsIndexFastHint: Reads the drives' file tables in seconds, which needs an administrator's rights once: Windows will ask. Without it the drives are read folder by folder, which takes longer and leaves out folders you may not open.
settingsIndexDeclined: Not read the fast way: the request was declined
settingsRulesHint: One a line. A path (D:\Cache, %TEMP%), a name or pattern (node_modules, *.tmp, build\out, **\obj\**), or /a regular expression/. Start a line with ! to leave what it covers out of results, - to put it after the others, + to put it before them, ++ to put it first of all.
settingsFiltersHint: One a line: keyword = what it lets through. Extensions (pdf docx), patterns (*.min.js), folder or file, and other keywords (@doc @img). A query asks for one with :@keyword. Start a line with + to show the kind among the buttons above the results, and with # to switch it off. The built-in kinds are doc, img, video, audio, zip and app; a line with one of their keywords replaces it.
searchContentHint: Type words to find inside files
settingsContentOn: Search inside files with a keyword
settingsContentHint: Type the keyword, a space, and words: files under the folder that hold every word are found, with the text around the first. PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel documents are read, and text files. Files over 10 MB are not read.
settingsSearchPrograms: Find apps and system settings when searching the whole computer
